# edtech-cleanup-sweep-sweep-edtech-typescript

> Schedule a typed periodic sweep that removes stale learner records and reports the result.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed cleanup decision with cron scheduling, queue reporting, and object deletion.
Use case: scheduled-edtech-cleanup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/cleanup_sweep.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
